correctness.rationale: For n>=3 and arbitrary positive degrees, independently projectivized n coefficient blocks carry a diagonal one-parameter torus action with base-B separated monomial weights (B>max degrees). Fixed coefficient systems are n-tuples of monomials. Avoiding every coordinate point forces a pure power of each of n variables; there are exactly n! such systems, each indeed base-point-free. Compactly supported Euler localization to fixed points is valid for complex quasiprojective torus varieties, giving chi_c(U)=n!. Product projective coefficient spaces have Euler ∏binom(n+d_i-1,n-1), so additivity gives the resultant formula. Direct independent monomial enumeration checked several multivariate degree choices; not a proof for arbitrary degrees.
